name: Gevrey-Chambertin
description: The King of Wines. Powerful, rich, and complex Pinot Noir.

parcels.name: Chambertin
parcels.description: The most famous Grand Cru, known for power and longevity.

parcels.name: Chambertin-Clos de Bèze
parcels.description: Complex, elegant, and often more aromatic than Chambertin.

parcels.name: Mazis-Chambertin
parcels.description: Rich and structured, located near Clos de Bèze.

parcels.name: Ruchottes-Chambertin
parcels.description: Known for finesse and elegance, located on the upper slope.

parcels.name: Chapelle-Chambertin
parcels.description: Below Clos de Bèze, often lighter and more accessible.

parcels.name: Griotte-Chambertin
parcels.description: Smallest Grand Cru, known for cherry notes (Griotte).

parcels.name: Latricières-Chambertin
parcels.description: Mineral-driven and elegant, south of Chambertin.

parcels.name: Charmes-Chambertin
parcels.description: Supple and round, one of the largest Grand Crus.

parcels.name: Mazoyères-Chambertin
parcels.description: Often labeled as Charmes-Chambertin, located lower on the slope.

parcels.name: Clos Saint-Jacques
parcels.description: Often considered equal to Grand Crus, located on a separate hill.
